page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top with page number at top left. Text runs top to bottom with two centred headings, a centred address line and a final paragraph ending mid-sentence at the foot of the column. No margin notes, footnotes, catchword or signature.

main_text.p: bra omnia Antichristianæ istius Hierarchiæ, cum sua idololatria, superstitione, traditionibus ac inventis humanis in exilium sempiternum damnabuntur, ne-que amplius funesta ista sectarum & separatistarum nomina audientur: Verum unus erit Deus, ejusque nomen ac cultus idem per totam infulam. Sic Deo erit gloria, regi honor, regnis gaudium, posteris so-latium, Christianis aliis ecclesiis exemplum quod laudent & imitentur; & obstinatis nostris hostibus confusio. Amen.

Aliud etiam scriptum typis excusum in Anglia spargendum curant, quo scopum consiliorum suo-rum per præsentem hanc[?] expeditionem declarant; & per quos factum fit quod, ad extrema hæc reme-dia protruderentur. De verbo fere in verbum trans-latum sic se habet.

head.i: Declaratio consilij exercitus Scoticani, ad fratres Anglos.

main_text.head: Per ordinum regni delegatos, Exercitus Imperatorem, Proceres, reliquosque exercitus ductores.
main_text.p: Moribus ita comparatum est, ut actiones etiam præstantissimas, honestissimo hominum consilio susceptas, præsentissima Dei manu, omnibusque conspicua providentia gubernatas, etsi prudentioribus, pieque sagacibus approbatas, cœcæ tamen hominum maleseriatorum[?] suspiciones in pe-jorem semper partem rapiant, importunæ cavillan-tium censuræ viam ubique aut invenientes aut fa-cientes reprehendant, imperitorum denique oci-umque amplexorum securitas damnet; præsertim vero pravorum improbitas, quibus nihil unquam placere

page.notes: Page number printed as "§42" with a decorative 5 in the old form, read as 542. Doubtful readings: "hanc" (the initial letter looks like a long s with a crossbar), and "maleseriatorum" (letters unclear). The text ends mid-sentence at the foot of the column; "placere" is the last full line, not a catchword. Printed hyphens kept on line-end breaks.
